# ruos

> A real desktop an assistant can use.

A real desktop an assistant can use.

This is an independent, art-directed explainer for ruvnet's ruos — it takes a newcomer from "never seen it" to "ready to implement", grounded in a real RVF knowledge base of the source.

## What it is
ruos: A shared desktop made physical: luminous layered windows, a visible action, and a fresh picture that closes the loop.

## For your AI
A downloadable knowledge pack (RVF vector KB + MCP server) ships with this page so your agent can search the source too: https://ruos-explainer.netlify.app/ruos-knowledge-pack.zip
